exposure: vulvar masses (including Bartholin cysts, Bartholin abscesses, labia major abscesses, and other uncommon pathologies)
cohort: The study included three exceptional instances and a consecutive series of five patients presenting with vulvar masses at a gynecology clinic.
finding: Vulvar masses can manifest in various forms, and it is crucial not to overlook pathologies other than common Bartholin cysts and abscesses, always considering the possibility of malignant pathologies.
